_note: Baseline environmental attributes for corridors in the district world graph, and economics defaults. Every value labelled per the COMPASS_DATA_LEDGER framework.

heatExposure.label: measured-derived
heatExposure.source: Daylight-mean (UTCI_sun − 26)/(46 − 26) from NEA 2024 hourly temp/RH/wind + SolarCal radiant load (engine/helios_engine/heat). Weather inputs validated vs NEA wet-bulb: MAE 0.37 °C over 8,766 h

rainExposure.label: calibrated proxy
rainExposure.source: SG ~167 rain days/yr; most footpaths uncovered outside station catchments

shadeScore.label: measured-derived
shadeScore.source: District mean of per-corridor building-shadow fraction: sun-position ray-cast over HDB + OSM heights (12 days × 13 daylight hours)

adoption_ramp.label: calibrated proxy
adoption_ramp.source: 10-yr logistic behaviour-adoption S-curve (EWI 2023); habit formation + network effects accrue over the decade rather than saturating in 4 years

line_buffer_km.label: calibrated proxy
line_buffer_km.source: Corridor influence buffer, near the 400 m catchment standard
